Minecraft 26.3 - CPU ONLY / Mesa llvmpipe

Renderer:
  Mesa llvmpipe (software OpenGL on CPU)
  Intel HD Graphics 2000 is not used for OpenGL rendering.

Forced environment:
  GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe
  LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=true
  MESA_LOADER_DRIVER_OVERRIDE=llvmpipe
  LP_NUM_THREADS=4

Window:
  640x360, fullscreen disabled where options.txt already exists.

Launcher:
  Legacy Launcher
  %APPDATA%\.tlauncher\legacy\Minecraft\TL.exe

Run:
  START_MINECRAFT_26_3_CPU_640x360.cmd
